mentions.name: Sanctum
mentions.description: Sanctum is a privacy-focused system that already includes traffic analysis protection via its shroud component. The author is working on extending it with the ability to build mixnets using Sanctum and its cathedrals, adding stronger anonymity networking on top of the existing protections.
mentions.problem: Traffic analysis, which Sanctum already mitigates with its shroud protections and which mixnets would address further
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on the ability to create mixnets with sanctum [0] and its cathedrals.

Sanctum already has very capable traffic analysis protections in place in the form of shroud, but being able to build mixnets will make it even more valuable.
